# axiz-metrics-spring-boot-autoconfigure

Generic event metrics with @Metered, catalog, common tags and cardinality protection (auto-configuration).

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-metrics-spring-boot-autoconfigure</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `AxizFailureClassifier` | Business, validation and security errors are `rejected` with the catalog code as reason; technical and external errors are `error` with their code. |
| `AxizMetricsAutoConfiguration` | Generic event metrics: the `EventMetrics` API, `Metered`, the meter filter that enforces declared tags and buckets, and the common tags `service`, `env`, `version` and `domain`. |
| `AxizMetricsProperties` | Generic event metrics (`axiz.metrics.*`), usually declared in the service ConfigMap. |
| `MeteredInterceptor` | Applies `Metered`: counts the call, times it and derives outcome and reason from the failure. |

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl spring/axiz-metrics-spring-boot-autoconfigure verify`.
